versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Monero Mining Profitability Calculator.
- Calculate estimated XMR earnings, electricity costs, net profit/loss, break-even, and ROI based on user hardware and market inputs.
- Support for custom inputs: hashrate, power consumption, electricity cost, network parameters.
- Includes built-in Python script example and usage instructions.
- Provides practical mining tips, profitability scenarios, and break-even analysis for different hardware setups.
